introHtml: Custom 1 USB flash drives offer a compact and practical promotional tool for trade shows, new hire kits, and client gifts. These drives typically feature 1GB or less storage, perfect for sharing digital brochures, product catalogs, or training materials. Choose from key-shaped, pen-style, or folding designs and imprint your logo with full-color or laser engraving. Their small size makes them easy to hand out and carry, ensuring your brand stays top of mind.
